title: docs(app-shell): record the objectui#7612 ruling where `AUTHOR_SHAPE_ONLY_TYPES` states its ingress condition (objectui#10150)
body:
Fixes #10150
Clause-②: no

## What

The docblock above `AUTHOR_SHAPE_ONLY_TYPES` in the metadata-admin `clientValidation` ended on a plan: switch the `sharing_rule` edit gate on once the `_diagnostics` ingress is closed, and not before. That condition was met. The switch was then put to the maintainer on objectui#7612, with the condition already measured, and the ruling was option A: the edit door stays with the server. So a reader who checked the stated condition would find it met, and the header gave them no reason to stop short of switching the gate on.

The ending now records the ruling where that reader meets the condition:

- that the ingress was closed, cited by content: objectui#7603 stripped the read decorations off the pending draft, and objectui#8181 hoisted the strip into `extractDraftBody`, which removes the spec's own list through the spec's `stripReadDecorations`;
- that the switch was therefore put to the maintainer on objectui#7612, with a finished implementation beside it (PR objectui#10054, which was not merged);
- the ruling: maintainer, 2026-09-20, option A, verbatim 「7612 只需要服务端校验」, with an English gloss;
- that a closed ingress is not a reason to take `sharing_rule` out of the set, and that only a new ruling re-opens the question.

Kept as it was: the measurement above it (the ADR-0010 envelope family, the `_diagnostics` read decoration, the objectstack#5316 inversion, the measured read-path table). One sentence in it quotes the pre-strip `getDraft().item` assembly, and it stays verbatim. The new ending marks it as the path objectui#6982 measured, and points at `ResourceEditPage.readDecorationStrip.test.tsx` for the live answer instead of restating that answer (AGENTS.md #9). `AUTHOR_SHAPE_ONLY_TYPES` still lists `sharing_rule`, and no code line in the file moved.

The header also names objectui#10150 as a second place where the ruling is recorded. The reason: from this container, the objectui#7612 issue page answers 404 today (see Acceptance notes).

## Premise, re-derived on `origin/main` (`8b1f0661`) before editing

- The header ended "Turning this gate on is gated on the `_diagnostics` ingress being closed first … Until then a gate here would refuse legitimate author input", and the set was `['sharing_rule']`.
- The precondition is met in code. All three `client.getDraft` results in `ResourceEditPage` go through `extractDraftBody(draftResp)` before the `{ ...baseline, ...draftReal }` merge. `extractDraftBody` in `@object-ui/data-objectstack` returns `stripReadDecorations(body)`, imported from `@objectstack/spec/kernel`.
- As the card warned, PR objectui#10054's shape (an empty set, and the BOTH DOORS comment) is not on `main`.

## The pin

`clientValidation.authorShapeRuling-10150.test.ts` sits beside the other `clientValidation` tests and runs in the unit project. It is a source scan of the ONE docblock directly above `const AUTHOR_SHAPE_ONLY_TYPES`. The test locates that docblock and does not mask anything.

- It requires the docblock to name `objectui#7612` and `extractDraftBody`. These are named subjects. The ruling's wording is not pinned, because nothing parses it.
- CONTROL: the same reader finds the measurement the header must keep (`ADR-0010`, `_diagnostics`, `objectstack#5316`). Its read is also bounded on both sides: the code above and the comment below are in the file but not in the block. So an empty or misplaced read cannot pass as a scan of nothing.

The pin cannot judge prose intent. A header that cites the ruling and also re-states the plan would pass. The pin's own docblock says so.

## Ablation (a one-time proof, run from the committed fix at `a87fe06e`)

The ablation ran through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode, inside a script with its own `trap` restore on EXIT, INT and TERM. The mutation swapped the new ending back for the old one.

- The anchor hit once, and its count went from 1 to 0. Blob `4181dbb6` became `d7ba23ed`, which is exactly the file's base blob on `8b1f0661`. On-disk counts while mutated: the old plan phrase 1, `objectui#7612` 0, `extractDraftBody` 0.
- While mutated: `Tests  1 failed | 1 passed (2)`. The failing case was `cites the ruling and the closed ingress by name, in the header itself`, and the CONTROL stayed green. That is the predicted direction: red.
- Restore: the blob is back to the HEAD blob `4181dbb6`, `git diff HEAD` is empty, and `git status` is clean.

The same ablation first ran at `0a03e7ea`, before the second-locus edit, with the same reading: 1 failed, 1 passed.

## Verification at HEAD `a87fe06e`

- The dependency closure was built first, through the shared verify lock: `pnpm turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/app-shell... --concurrency=2`, 29 of 29 tasks successful.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) exits 0 through the lock. The test program includes the pin (`--listFilesOnly`: 1 hit).
- The pin, every `clientValidation` neighbour, the cited `ResourceEditPage.readDecorationStrip.test.tsx` and `draft-envelope.test.ts`, repo-root form: `Test Files  12 passed (12)`, `Tests  166 passed (166)`.
- `pnpm check:control-bytes` passes. `pnpm check:new-line-citations` reports 0 new citations over the 3 files compared, with its synthetic controls PASS. `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` passes, with an empty frontmatter.
- These also exit 0 at this head: `check-test-path-roots`, `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask` (no carrier outside DEBT), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-pending-changeset-literals`, `check-type-check-coverage`, `check-lint-coverage`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:metadata-write-doors`, `check-vi-mock-specifiers`, and `check-governed-queue-guard --test` (`NOT GOVERNED`, 3 paths).
- `check-changeset-claims` (report-only) names two pending changesets that mention `clientValidation.ts`. One is about `LOADERS.flow` and the other about the retired `theme` entry. This change touches neither.

## Lint: narrowed, with the narrowing proven

- **Population, from ESLint's own config:** both touched `.ts` files are linted (2 JSON entries, no ignore notice). The changeset is outside the population: `File ignored because no matching configuration was supplied`.
- **Count, from `--format json` with `--no-inline-config` (the CI form):** 2 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings.
- **Invariance:** `eslint.config.js` enables no type-aware linting (0 hits for `projectService` or `parserOptions`; control: 13 hits for `rules`). No local rule under `eslint-rules/` reads the filesystem (0 of 10 files; control: 9 of them carry `create`). So this diff cannot move a verdict on any untouched file.

## Changeset: empty frontmatter, measured

The presence gate requires a changeset, because published `src` changed. It is declared as releasing nothing, based on a measurement of the emit:

- The emitted `clientValidation.d.ts` has 0 hits for `AUTHOR_SHAPE_ONLY_TYPES` and 0 for `objectui#7612`. Control: the exported `hasClientValidator` and its docblock, 1 hit each. Re-measured at `a87fe06e` with a declaration-only emit, with the same reading.
- The emitted `.js` carries the comment. With comments stripped, the TypeScript emit of the file is byte-identical between base and HEAD.
- The pin is not emitted.

## Acceptance notes

- Out of scope and untouched, as the claim declares: `clientValidation.optOuts.test.ts` carries the same pre-strip account in two docblocks. The case headed "THE LOAD-BEARING PIN" says `ResourceEditPage` assembles its draft from `client.getDraft().item` "and strips nothing". The block above it calls the decoration pin the one that says "WHY the door must stay shut". Since objectui#7612, the door stays shut because of the ruling, not because the decoration arrives. The assertions are still true; only their stated reasons are out of date. Carrier: whoever next edits that file. None is named.
- The `LOADERS` comment beside `sharing_rule` ("CREATE ONLY — see `AUTHOR_SHAPE_ONLY_TYPES` above for why this shape may not judge a stored body") is left as it is. The claim fences everything but the header, and that comment points at the header, which now gives the answer.
- From this container, `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/7612` and the issue's web page answer 404, and so does a single-comment GET on its thread. The comment list and the timeline answer 200 (state `not_planned` at 2026-09-20T14:46Z, no transfer event). Controls: objectui#7603, #8181 and #10054 answer 200 on the same endpoint. The cause was not measured. That 404 is why the header also names objectui#10150. The quotation in the header does not depend on either card.
- The commits carry no attribution trailers, so they are model-free by omission. Attribution is this body and the session below.
